parts.label: (a)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
State $\dfrac{dV}{dt}=5000-kh^2$ - B1, SOI.

Use $V=2500h$ and the chain rule to obtain $(\text{their }dV/dt)/2500$ - *M1, or equivalent $\dfrac{dh}{dt}=\dfrac{5000-kh^2}{2500}$.

Use $h=20$, $dh/dt=0.4$ to obtain $k$ - dM1: $0.4=(5000-400k)/2500\Rightarrow k=10$.

Obtain $\dfrac{dh}{dt}=\dfrac{500-h^2}{250}$ from correct working - A1, AG. A complete statement is required; condone 'divide by 10' instead of showing cancellation.

Printed total: 4.

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Separate variables correctly - B1, e.g. $\int\dfrac1{500-h^2}\,dh=\dfrac1{250}\int1\,dt$. Condone missing integral signs or missing $dh,dt$, but not both.

Obtain $\dfrac1{250}t$ - B1, or equivalent depending on placement of 250.

Obtain $\dfrac1{2\sqrt{500}}\ln\left|\dfrac{\sqrt{500}+h}{\sqrt{500}-h}\right|$ - B1, or equivalent such as $\dfrac1{20\sqrt5}\ln\left|\dfrac{10\sqrt5+h}{10\sqrt5-h}\right|$. Coefficients depend on placement of 250; condone missing modulus signs.

Use $t=0,h=0$ in an expression $pt+q\ln(a+h)+r\ln(b-h)$ to obtain the constant, or use limits in a definite integral - M1. Requires a value for the constant; M0 if their equation has no solution or they never had a constant. Need an indication the conclusion uses $t=0,h=0$.

Obtain $t=16.1$ s - A1; accept AWRT.

Printed total: 5.
